mainContent.title: Spine Surgery Specialist
mainContent.paragraph1: Dr. Aldo Avellaneda is a highly qualified spine surgeon who specializes in complex spinal procedures and minimally invasive techniques.
mainContent.paragraph2: With extensive training and years of experience, he has established himself as a trusted expert in the treatment of severe spinal conditions, including cases that were previously considered inoperable.

specialties.title: Specialties
specialties.subtitle: Specialized spine surgery services with cutting-edge techniques

items.title: Minimally Invasive Surgery
items.description: Advanced spine techniques that reduce recovery time and minimize surgical trauma.

items.title: Complex Disc Herniations
items.description: Specialized treatment of complex disc herniations with personalized approach for each patient.

items.title: Scoliosis and Deformities
items.description: Surgical correction of scoliosis and other spinal deformities with state-of-the-art technology.

items.title: Spinal Fusion
items.description: Advanced spinal fusion procedures to stabilize and relieve pain in degenerative conditions.

items.title: Spinal Stenosis
items.description: Effective treatment of spinal stenosis to relieve nerve compression and improve mobility.

items.title: Spinal Tumors
items.description: Specialized surgery for spinal tumors with precise techniques and comprehensive patient care.

timeline.mainTitle: Dr. Aldo's expertise in spine surgery:

education.title: Education and specialized training
education.description: Dr. Aldo's education and specialized training have positioned him as a leader in spine surgery, particularly in complex and minimally invasive procedures. His academic and professional training includes:
items: Bachelor's Degree in Medicine and Surgery from the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM).
Diplomas in Medicine and Complexity Sciences and Emergency Medicine from the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM).
Specialization in Orthopedics from the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM).
Advanced training in minimally invasive spine surgery — Multiple international programs focused on endoscopic and robot-assisted techniques.

experience.title: Professional experience and career highlights
experience.description: Dr. Aldo combines surgical expertise with academic contributions, regularly training other surgeons and contributing to the advancement of spine surgery. His career includes:
items: Professor at the Yucatan College of Orthopedics, leading specialized sessions on early-onset scoliosis (2019).
Speaker at the National Congress of Spine Surgery in Mexico (2017), presentation on advanced surgical techniques.
Faculty member at the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM) (2012), teaching orthopedics and respiratory system courses.
Performing over 300 to 400 spine surgeries per year, making him one of the most experienced spine specialists in the region.

certifications.title: Certifications, recognitions and memberships
certifications.description: Dr. Aldo holds prestigious certifications and memberships that underscore his expertise and dedication to patient care:
items: Board certification in orthopedic surgery — Certified by the Mexican Council of Traumatology and Orthopedics (2017-2022).
Active member of international spine surgery organizations, regularly interacting with world experts.
Regularly interacting with experts from around the world focused on advancing minimally invasive spine surgery.

continuousLearning.title: Commitment to continuous learning and medical innovation
continuousLearning.description: Dr. Aldo actively participates in continuing education, research and international collaboration to refine spine surgery techniques. His professional development includes:
items: Symposium on spinal tumors and deformities — São Paulo, Brazil (2018).
Advanced practical course on cervical spine surgery — Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (2018).
Clinical skills laboratory for minimally invasive lumbar surgery — (2018).
Multiple courses and certifications from AOSpine Latin America, focusing on trauma, degenerative conditions and advanced minimally invasive techniques (2017).
Research on adult sagittal balance and cervical disc arthroplasty with AO North America (2017).

contactInfo.title: Contact and consultation information
contactInfo.paragraph1: If you are considering spine surgery and want to consult with one of the leading experts in the field, Dr. Aldo Avellaneda and his team are ready to help.
contactInfo.paragraph2: Dr. Aldo is committed to providing personalized, innovative and effective spine care for local and international patients. Whether you are seeking to relieve chronic pain, seeking a second opinion or exploring minimally invasive surgical options, his expertise can guide you towards the best possible outcome.
